    Ordinary meeting

    Tuesday 4 August 2026

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30pm, Tuesday 4 August 2026 in the Council Chambers (420 Glen Eira Road, Caulfield).

    Key tasks

    • Live Stream

    Entry is via the Clocktower entrance, Corner Hawthorn and Glen Eira Roads. Face masks are strongly recommended when you can’t physically distance.

    The Ordinary Meeting of Council will also be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Records of Assembly

    1. 16 June 2026 Assembly

    2. 22 June 2026 Assembly

    3. 30 June 2026 Pre-meeting

    Officer Reports

    • 10.1 Draft Circular Economy Plan 2026 - 2030
    • 10.2 Strategic Asset Reserve Policy
    • 10.3 Sportsground and Associated Facilities Allocation Policy
    • 10.4 Caulfield Civic Precinct Concept Plan
    • 10.5 Investment Policy Review and Adoption
    • 10.6 Australian Local Government Association National General Assembly 2026
    • 10.7 Quarterly Reporting of Community Grants
    • 10.8 Recruitment of Independent Member for Audit and Risk Committee

    Urgent business item — 32-46 Huntley Road, Bentleigh

    Please see the pdf attachment of this report attached below.

    On 9 August 2022 Council issued a Notice of Refusal for a planning permit application at 32-46 Huntley Road, Bentleigh.

    A review of this decision has been lodged to the Victorian Civil and Administrative Tribunal (VCAT). The VCAT hearing starts 31 January 2023 and will run for six days.

    Council is required to form a position on the amended plans which will be brought to Council on 13 December 2022 during Urgent Business.

    Ordinary meeting

    Tuesday 5 April 2022

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 5 April 2022. The Ordinary Meeting of Council will be held in the Council Chamber and live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Key tasks

    • Watch the meeting

    11.1 - 10-16 Selwyn Street, Elsternwick

    Council will be considering a confidential item at the Ordinary Council Meeting on Tuesday 5 April 2022 in relation to 10-16 Selwyn Street, Elsternwick (item 11.1 in the agenda). It is anticipated that the confidential item will be brought forward to an earlier stage of the meeting. The live streaming of the meeting will be suspended during consideration of the confidential item. After consideration of the item, the live streaming will resume and it is expected that Council will provide further details about the item. To watch the live stream, visit: https://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 5 April 2022 in the Council Chambers (420 Glen Eira Road, Caulfield). Entry is via the Clocktower entrance, Corner Hawthorn and Glen Eira Roads. It is currently a requirement that attendees show proof of their full-vaccination status to attend Council meetings in-person. A mask must also be carried and is required to be worn if unable to socially distance. Attendance numbers at the meeting will be limited by seating capacity. Entry may not be granted once capacity is reached.

    The Ordinary Meeting of Council will also be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Please note
    If a technical problem is encountered during the meeting, which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned for 10 minutes from the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting.
    In the event the meeting cannot be resumed within 30 minutes of the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned, to be resumed on Wednesday 6 April 2022 at 7.30 pm via live-streaming on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).
    Council is not responsible for any data usage charges or technical difficulties that members of the public may experience in accessing Council’s live-stream or recordings of meetings.
    A copy of each of the live-streamed meetings is placed on Council’s website the day after the meeting (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Ordinary meeting

    Tuesday 14 December 2021

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 14 December 2021 in the Council Chambers.

    Key tasks

    • Watch the meeting

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 14 December 2021 in the Council Chambers (420 Glen Eira Road, Caulfield). Entry is via the Clocktower entrance, Corner Hawthorn and Glen Eira Roads. It is currently a requirement that attendees use the Victorian Government QR Code Service to check-in and show proof of their full-vaccination status to attend Council meetings in-person. A mask must also be carried and is required to be worn if unable to socially distance. Attendance numbers at the meeting will be limited by seating capacity. Entry may not be granted once capacity is reached.

    The Ordinary Meeting of Council will also be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Please note
    If a technical problem is encountered during the meeting, which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned for 10 minutes from the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting.
    In the event the meeting cannot be resumed within 30 minutes of the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned, to be resumed on Wednesday 15 December 2021 at 7.30 pm via live-streaming on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).
    Council is not responsible for any data usage charges or technical difficulties that members of the public may experience in accessing Council’s live-stream or recordings of meetings.
    A copy of each of the live-streamed meetings is placed on Council’s website the day after the meeting (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Ordinary meeting

    Tuesday 8 June 2021

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 8 June 2021. The Ordinary Meeting of Council will be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Key tasks

    • Watch webcast

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at virtually at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 8 June 2021. This Ordinary Meeting of Council will be live-streamed on Council’s website. Public Participation is not available for this meeting. Public Questions may be submitted no later than 12 noon on the business day before the meeting, in accordance with Written Public Question guidelines.

    The temporary measures of the Local Government Act 2020 permit Councillors to participate in a council meeting by electronic means of communication. The public is invited to view the Ordinary Meeting of Council on Tuesday 9 June 2021 at 7.30 pm on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Please note
    If a technical problem is encountered during the meeting, which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned for 10 minutes from the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting.
    In the event the meeting cannot be resumed within 30 minutes of the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned, to be resumed on Wednesday 9 June 2021 at 7.30 pm via live-streaming on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).
    Council is not responsible for any data usage charges or technical difficulties that members of the public may experience in accessing Council’s live-stream or recordings of meetings.
    A copy of each of the live-streamed meetings is placed on Council’s website the day after the meeting (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Ordinary meeting

    Wednesday 19 May 2021

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Wednesday 19 May 2021. The Ordinary Meeting of Council will be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Key tasks

    • Watch webcast

    Ordinary meetings of Glen Eira City Council are held in the Council Chamber at Glen Eira Town Hall, on the corner of Glen Eira and Hawthorn Roads, Caulfield. Get information on meeting dates and how you can participate.  Meetings will also continue to be live streamed for your convenience.

    COVID requirements if attending a Council Meeting

    A QR Code will be placed at the entrances to the Council Chamber. 

    Please register prior to entering the Council Chamber.

    Once in the Chamber, please remain seated.  If there are no available seats, please move through the Chamber to the next area where you will be able to view the meeting on a T.V. that will be set up for you.  It is against current COVID restrictions for us to have people standing in the Council Chamber and the number of people allowed in this area.

    Council will be guided by restrictions set by DHHS which may lead to variations of attendance at Council meetings and public participation.  Temporary measures still in place under the Local Government Act 2020 allows Council to return to holding Council meetings virtually should the need arise.

    Tuesday 16 March 2021

    An Ordinary Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 16 March 2021. The Ordinary Meeting of Council will be live-streamed on Council’s website. 

    Key tasks

    • Watch webcast

The provisions in Part 12 permit Councillors to participate in a council meeting by electronic means of communication. The public is invited to view the Ordinary Meeting of Council on Tuesday 16 March 2021 at 7.30pm on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    • Tuesday 5 May 2020

    Special meeting

    Tuesday 5 May 2020

    A Special Meeting of Council for Glen Eira City Council will be held at 7.30 pm, Tuesday 5 May 2020. The Special Meeting of Council will be live-streamed on Council’s website.

    Key tasks

    • View webcast

    The COVID-19 Omnibus (Emergency Measures) Act 2020, which received Royal Assent on 24 April 2020, amends the Local Government Act 2020 by inserting a new Part 12 – ‘COVID-19 temporary measures. The provisions in Part 12 permit Councillors to participate in a council meeting by electronic means of communication. The public is invited to view the Special Meeting of Council on 5 May 2020 at 7.30 pm on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/ ).

    Please note

    If a technical problem is encountered during the meeting, which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned for 10 minutes from the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting.

    In the event the meeting cannot be resumed within 30 minutes of the commencement of the technical problem which prevents Council from live-streaming the meeting, then the meeting will be considered to be adjourned, to be resumed on Wednesday 6 May at 7.30 pm via live-streaming on Council’s website (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Council is not responsible for any data usage charges or technical difficulties that members of the public may experience in accessing Council’s live-stream or recordings of meetings.

    A copy of each of the live-streamed meetings is placed on Council’s website the day after the meeting (http://webcast.gleneira.vic.gov.au/).

    Ordinary meeting

    Tuesday 28 April 2020

    Ordinary meeting of Glen Eira City Council held on Tuesday 28 April 2020. 

    Key tasks

    • View webcast

    The Minister for Local Government has foreshadowed that Parliament will this week consider an amendment to the Local Government Act 2020 to enable councils to hold meetings via video link with effect from 1 May 2020, and for the duration of the COVID-19 pandemic.   

    The next Ordinary Council Meeting of Glen Eira City Council is scheduled for Tuesday 28 April. While this meeting will proceed as planned, a number of Councillors have already indicated that they will be unable to attend the meeting due to COVID-19 restrictions.  

    There are many matters currently under consideration by Council that warrant full participation in the debate and decision-making process. For this reason, the Agenda for the meeting of 28 April will be restricted to administrative matters only, and those matters that cannot reasonably be delayed. 

    A Special Meeting of the Council will be scheduled for Tuesday 5 May, via video link, to consider all other matters that would have normally been considered on 28 April. It will be a public meeting livestreamed via Council’s website. Along with other items, the Agenda will include a paper on Action on Climate Change.

    Reception and reading of petitions

    A petition containing 618 signatures was submitted to the Council Meeting.

    The petition read as follows:
    This petition draws to the attention of the Council the need for a Climate Emergency Declaration and Action Plan.
